answer_1.quote: In this work, we analyse idiom processing for pre-trained NMT Transformer models for seven European languages by comparing literal and figurative occurrences of PIEs.
answer_1.outputs: Translations of sentences containing potentially idiomatic expressions

answer_4.quote: To assess the quality of the heuristic method, one (near) native speaker per target language annotated 350 samples
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked whether (1) the English word was present in the translation (copy), (2) whether there was a literal translation for the word, or (3) whether neither of those options were suited, referred to as the 'paraphrase'.
